Casablanca Digitizes Road Network Management with GIS-Based System

📅 2026-07-07 ✍️ Le Matin 🏷️ Casablanca, GIS, SIG, road network management, geo-referenced database, digital transformation, Morocco, road maintenance, infrastructure, municipal planning
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Casablanca launches a digital overhaul of its road network management using a geo-referenced GIS database, moving from reactive road maintenance to data-driven planning with exhaustive technical inventory and annual maintenance plans.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The Commune of Casablanca plans a comprehensive digital diagnosis of its road network with a geo-referenced database (SIG)
  • First phase involves an exhaustive technical inventory of the road network — structural roads, secondary roads, and all pathways
  • The GIS system serves as the foundation for annual and multi-year road maintenance planning
  • Moves the municipality from reactive (fix-when-broken) to proactive, data-driven road asset management
  • Part of Casablanca's broader digital transformation of municipal infrastructure management
